title: Classifying spaces of weak equivalences in a model category
statement:
Use model categories and homotopy coherent localization as in [lem-coef-cosimplicial-frame-mapping], and nerves, spaces and cores as in [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $\mathcal M$ be a model category, with universes enlarged for all nerves below, and let $\mathcal S$ be a full subcategory closed under weak equivalences in both directions. Write $w\mathcal S$ for the category with the same objects and only weak equivalences as morphisms. Let $(\mathcal M_\infty)_{\mathcal S}$ be the full subcategory of the homotopy coherent localization on objects represented by $\mathcal S$. The localization functor induces a weak homotopy equivalence
$$N(w\mathcal S)\simeq\big((\mathcal M_\infty)_{\mathcal S}\big)^{\simeq}.$$
The superscript denotes the core, retaining precisely equivalences and their higher homotopies. Thus $\pi_0N(w\mathcal S)$ is the set of isomorphism classes of objects of $\mathcal S$ in $\operatorname{Ho}(\mathcal M)$, and the path space between two represented objects is the union of the equivalence components of their derived mapping space. Inclusions of the full cofibrant, full fibrant, and full bifibrant subcategories of $\mathcal S$, each with only weak equivalences as morphisms, induce weak homotopy equivalences on nerves.

Let $L:\mathcal M\rightleftarrows\mathcal N:R$ be a Quillen adjunction between model categories, and let $\mathcal T$ be a full subcategory of $\mathcal N$ closed under weak equivalences in both directions. Suppose the adjunction is a Quillen equivalence, meaning its derived functors are inverse equivalences, and those derived functors carry the classes of objects represented by $\mathcal S$ and $\mathcal T$ bijectively onto one another. It then induces a weak homotopy equivalence $N(w\mathcal S)\simeq N(w\mathcal T)$. On cofibrant objects it is induced by the left Quillen functor when that functor carries the chosen classes to one another, and on arbitrary objects it is computed after cofibrant replacement. These comparisons are natural for the Quillen functors and their derived units and counits.

mathlib_searches.verdict: no match: nerveFunctor and nerveFunctorCompHoFunctorIso describe ordinary categorical nerves and their ordinary homotopy category. CofibrantObject localization gives an equivalence of ordinary localizations, not a comparison of nerves of weak-equivalence categories with the core of an infinity localization. Read SimplicialNerve.lean:14-72 and CofibrantObjectHomotopy.lean:60-96. CechNerve.lean:14-65 constructs an ordinary Cech nerve, not the model-category moduli theorem; the other classifying-space grep hits concern group resolutions. Both semantic phrasings were inspected.
